landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wi-fi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at a different time, with a weak mobile signal or none. HatchGrab was made exactly for that.
landing.does.capacityBody: Decide how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and on the card terminal you already take payment with.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, locations and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Messages on your WhatsApp get an answer while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon messages on your WhatsApp will get an answer while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram follow.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online orders pause automatically so customers don’t send orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders in the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Set everything up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things need sorting — and for two of them a photo is enough.
landing.steps.menuBody: Photograph your menu board or paste the text. Items, prices and extras come across by themselves. You just check everything is correct.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Have it on your website? We will take it from there and keep it updated regularly. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what we find.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR code on the vehicle. Orders arrive on your screen in the order you need to prepare them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made taking orders much easier for us. Everything is organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many pizzas we have left to sell — and the time slots are fantastic for villages where it gets busy.
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you need to.
landing.pricing.switchBody: See how much you would pay for the same orders with HatchGrab. Takes about a minute.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.metaDescription: Clear answers for food truck owners about HatchGrab’s prices, setting up, taking orders and payment by card or at collection.
landing.final.title: Want to see how simple setup is?
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and in under 60 seconds we’ll turn it into an ordering page that works, for you to try. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, then decide.

featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take orders at the counter and manage them, with payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS) and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders pause so customers don’t send orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from a web browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap — customers see it greyed out straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity that goes down as orders arrive, and the item is then automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to an order when you give it to the customer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, e.g. for food hygiene, insurance and gas installation safety. We’ll remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs you and see what you really earned at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see, with order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need to be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection slot, so demand is spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Decide how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you don’t have to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck is shown on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, locations and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp automatic replies, for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.

aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection time and fewer of the same questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.title: Built around how food trucks really work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab came from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I launched Village Foodie, an online directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software intended specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep a smooth flow of orders and spend less time answering the same questions.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
